item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
• Fixed cleanup rows that reappeared after deletion by making retained-session targets scan only the children that cleanup can actually remove.
  • Added post-clean verification so rows stay visible with a clear message if files remain because they are protected, in use, or regenerated.
  • Added per-target review controls for deleting retained recent sessions when users explicitly want everything removed.
  • Added Select All in the bottom bar, including destructive rows.
